name: dropdown-menu
purpose: Overlay menu that opens from a consumer-supplied trigger and renders a list of selectable options grouped into named sections. The root `DropdownMenu` owns open/closed state, positioning, focus return, and keyboard navigation; `DropdownMenu.Trigger` wires `aria-haspopup`/`aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` onto whatever element the consumer passes through its slot; `DropdownMenu.Group` groups options under an optional label; `DropdownMenu.Item` (the shadcn / Radix name) is the selectable row with leading/trailing/command affordances, and with `type="checkbox"` or `type="radio"` it becomes a checkable item (`menuitemcheckbox` / `menuitemradio`). `DropdownMenu.Sub`, `DropdownMenu.SubTrigger` and `DropdownMenu.SubContent` nest a sub-menu that opens on hover or with `ArrowRight` and nests to any depth. Replaces and removes the legacy monolithic input `dropdown` and the previous `dropdown-menu` composition — there is one `DropdownMenu` in the project, in `navigation/`.
useWhen: Use DropdownMenu for a list of actions opened from a button (row actions, kebab, More); for the same actions on right-click or long-press use ContextMenu, and for a searchable palette use Command.
A menu of actions opened from a button: row actions, an account menu, an overflow ("more") menu.
Options grouped under section labels, optionally with keyboard-shortcut hints.
avoidWhen: Choosing a value that a form submits → use `select` (inside a `field` for a label).
A primary action joined to a menu of alternatives → use `split-button`.
A searchable palette of commands → use `command`.
Free-form or interactive content such as forms or filters → use `popover`.
related: split-button` — composes `DropdownMenu` for its chevron menu.
select` — form control with a field trigger and a bound value.
popover` — same trigger and anchoring model, with free-form content instead of option rows.
command` — modal ⌘K palette with search and filtering.
bestPractices: Give every `DropdownMenu.Item` a unique `value` and handle the root `select` event as `(event, value)`. The panel closes and focus returns to the trigger on its own.
selected` is a display flag. The dropdown never sets it, so derive it from your own state.

Use the `command` prop or the `trailing` slot on an option, not both. A `command` shortcut is live while its option is mounted (inside a group, only while the panel is open). Every menu on the page shares one `window` listener, so a shortcut fires one option only: the one in the open menu, else the one whose trigger has focus, else the first registered.

Write `DropdownMenu.Item` (also exported as `DropdownMenuItem`); 6.0 removed the `DropdownMenu.Option` alias and the `left` / `right` slots. Items may sit directly in the root: an item outside a group renders inside the panel like a grouped one.
Add a `label` to each `DropdownMenu.Group` when there is more than one group. Put search in the root `header` slot and footer actions in `footer`; those regions stay outside the scrolling list.

Nest at most two levels of sub-menus; deeper menus are hard to steer with a pointer. Put the `DropdownMenu.Sub` inside a `DropdownMenu.Group`, and the sub-menu's options inside a `DropdownMenu.Group` in `DropdownMenu.SubContent`, the same way as the top level.

Use `type="checkbox"` for independent on/off settings and `type="radio"` for one choice among the options of one `DropdownMenu.Group`. Drive `selected` from your own state in the `select` handler; checkable options keep the panel open so several can be toggled in a row.

Bind the open state with `v-model:open`, or `:open` plus an `@update:open` handler typed `(open: boolean) => void`. The payload is always a `boolean`, so the handler needs no cast and no `Boolean(...)`.

props.name: placement
props.doc: Where the panel opens relative to the trigger. `'auto'` picks the best-fitting corner at open time based on viewport space.

props.name: offset
props.doc: Pixel gap between the trigger and the panel.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Prevents the trigger from opening the panel and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Initial open state when uncontrolled (`v-model:open` unbound).

events.name: select
events.notes: Fires when an enabled option is activated (click, `Enter`/`Space`, or a `command` shortcut). `event` is the activation event; `value` is the activated option's identifier. The panel closes automatically and focus returns to the trigger when activated from inside the open panel, except for `type="checkbox"` / `type="radio"` options, which keep it open. Options inside a sub-menu emit on the same root event.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Place `<DropdownMenu.Trigger>` followed by one or more `<DropdownMenu.Group>`.

slots.name: header
slots.notes: Sticky region rendered above the scrollable group list (e.g. search input).

slots.name: footer
slots.notes: Sticky region rendered below the scrollable group list (e.g. footer action).

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DropdownMenuGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-group'
  import DropdownMenuOption from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-option'
  import DropdownMenuRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-root'
  import DropdownMenuTrigger from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-trigger'
  import IconButton from '@aziontech/webkit/icon-button'
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenuRoot>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <IconButton
        variant="outline"
        icon="ai ai-plus"
        aria-label="Open menu"
      />
    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuGroup>
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="profile"
        label="Profile"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="settings"
        label="Settings"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="billing"
        label="Billing"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="invite"
        label="Invite members"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="logs"
        label="Audit log"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="signout"
        label="Sign out"
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
  </DropdownMenuRoot>
</template>

examples.name: Groups
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DropdownMenuGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-group'
  import DropdownMenuOption from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-option'
  import DropdownMenuRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-root'
  import DropdownMenuTrigger from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-trigger'
  import IconButton from '@aziontech/webkit/icon-button'
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenuRoot>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <IconButton
        variant="outline"
        icon="ai ai-plus"
        aria-label="Open menu"
      />
    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuGroup label="Account">
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="profile"
        label="Profile"
        command="⌘P"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="settings"
        label="Settings"
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
    <DropdownMenuGroup label="Workspace">
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="invite"
        label="Invite members"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="logs"
        label="Audit log"
        selected
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
  </DropdownMenuRoot>
</template>

examples.name: States
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DropdownMenuGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-group'
  import DropdownMenuOption from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-option'
  import DropdownMenuRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-root'
  import DropdownMenuTrigger from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu-trigger'
  import IconButton from '@aziontech/webkit/icon-button'
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenuRoot :open="true">
    <DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <IconButton
        variant="outline"
        icon="ai ai-plus"
        aria-label="Open menu"
      />
    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuGroup label="Option states">
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="default"
        label="Default"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="selected"
        label="Selected"
        selected
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="disabled"
        label="Disabled"
        disabled
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
  </DropdownMenuRoot>
</template>
